metadata.description: Socratic thinking-guidance skills for AI coding agents — clarify the real problem before you write code, instead of diving into chaotic coding

plugins.name: socratic-coding
plugins.description: Use when a coding request is vague, open-ended, architectural, large/cross-cutting, or you are in plan mode — runs a Socratic clarification pass (real problem, hidden assumptions, success criteria) before writing code, then converges and executes. Skips trivial well-specified changes.
